idea: Resume and LinkedIn review for final-year engineering students before placements

strategist.problem: Final-year engineering student in India, 2-6 weeks before campus placements, gets zero interview calls after applying because their resume and LinkedIn profile don't pass the recruiter or ATS scan.
strategist.target_customer: Final-year B.Tech student at an Indian engineering college with campus placements starting within 8 weeks, who has already sent 10+ applications with no callbacks and can pay a one-time ₹300-₹800 fee from savings or pocket money.
strategist.mission: Give final-year engineering students a recruiter-ready resume and LinkedIn profile before their placement drive starts, so their application gets shortlisted instead of filtered out.

competitors.name: Free AI resume tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Kickresume, Rezi free tiers)
competitors.differentiator: We review against actual Indian campus placement and recruiter expectations, with a human pass and campus-specific fixes, not generic AI output.

competitors.name: Freelance resume writers on Fiverr/Upwork
competitors.differentiator: We know Indian engineering placement formats and campus drive requirements; they write generic international resumes and charge in dollars with slow turnaround.

competitors.name: College training and placement cell (TPO) resume workshops
competitors.differentiator: TPO sessions are one-size-fits-all group lectures with no per-student rewrite; we deliver a reviewed, edited resume and LinkedIn profile for one student.

scope_cuts: No custom resume-builder SaaS or web app — a service with manual review ships in 3-4 weeks; software would blow the ₹15,000 build budget.
No interview prep, aptitude training, or mock interview service line — resume and LinkedIn review only until one paying customer converts.
No hiring of designers or writers — founder plus one part-time batchmate handles reviews manually at first.

stack.name: Carrd
stack.why: One-page portfolio site to display 3 pilot reviews and host a Razorpay payment link for ₹300-₹800 fees.

stack.name: Razorpay
stack.why: Generates UPI payment links for one-time resume review fees without needing a full e-commerce setup.

stack.name: WhatsApp Business
stack.why: Free app to manage client chats, send edited PDFs, and handle quick replies for 15-hour/week capacity.

stack.name: Google Docs
stack.why: Free collaborative editor for students to share resume drafts and for the founder to make tracked changes.

stack.name: Canva
stack.why: Free tier to create simple LinkedIn banner images and visual resume templates for students who need design help.

stack.name: Notion
stack.why: Free student plan to track 10+ client reviews, deadlines, and feedback loops in a simple database.

ai_tools.name: Claude
ai_tools.why: Free tier to draft resume bullet points, optimize LinkedIn summaries, and check ATS keyword density for Indian placements.

ai_tools.name: Gemini
ai_tools.why: Free tier to analyze specific Indian campus placement job descriptions and suggest role-specific skill keywords.

mvp_features: Resume Review: 1-page PDF rewrite with 10 tracked changes, ATS keyword optimization, and 15-minute voice note explanation.
LinkedIn Profile Audit: 5 specific headline and summary rewrites plus 3 connection request templates for target recruiters.
Combined Placement Pack: Resume rewrite + LinkedIn audit + 1-page 'About Me' script for placement cell interviews.

tool_costs.price_note: 2% + GST per payment, no setup fee or AMC. Price checked 2026-11-02 on https://razorpay.com/pricing/

first_10_steps: Register a free Carrd account and build a one-page site titled 'Resume Review for Final Year Engineers' with a placeholder for 3 case studies.
Buy a .in domain for ₹75 and connect it to the Carrd site to look professional for college seniors and juniors.
Create a free Razorpay account and generate a ₹500 payment link for the 'Resume Review' service to test UPI checkout.
Recruit 3 batchmates for free pilot reviews in exchange for testimonials and before/after screenshots of their resumes.
Use Claude free tier to rewrite the 3 pilot resumes, focusing on Indian placement keywords like 'Campus Drive' and 'Core Engineering'.
Post the 3 before/after resume screenshots in 5 college WhatsApp groups with the caption 'Got 3 interviews after this rewrite'.
Set up a Notion database with columns for 'Student Name', 'College', 'Review Status', and 'Payment Link Sent' to track 10 clients.
Draft a 3-bullet WhatsApp template message: 'Hi [Name], I review resumes for [College] placements. ₹500 for a 1-page rewrite + LinkedIn fix. Link here.'
Send the WhatsApp template to 20 final-year students in your hostel and class groups, offering the first 2 reviews at ₹300 to get initial cash flow.
Deliver the first 2 paid reviews within 48 hours, ask for a 2-sentence testimonial, and update the Carrd site with the new proof.

Marketing budget (WhatsApp group posts, ₹100 Instagram boost per campaign, 3 campaigns/month)

revenue_targets.notes: 3 free pilots converted + 2 hostel referrals at ₹500-₹800 one-time fees.
One batchmate joins part-time for delivery; WhatsApp template scaled to 5 college groups.
Placement season peak; Carrd site updated with 10+ before/after case studies pulling organic LinkedIn inbound.

key_assumptions: Target customer pays ₹300-₹800 one-time from savings because placement season is a high-stakes, one-shot event (stated in strategist target_customer).
Blended avg_revenue_per_customer of ₹550 assumes 60% buy the ₹500 Resume Review, 25% buy the ₹800 Pack, 15% buy the ₹300 LinkedIn Audit.
delivery_cost_per_customer of ₹45 covers Razorpay ~2% transaction fee plus amortized Canva/Claude heavy-use months; founder time is not paid.
Founder can commit ₹15,000 of savings (mid of ₹5,000-₹25,000 range) as starting capital.

channels.name: Campus WhatsApp groups (hostel, class, branch and final-year batches)
channels.tactic: Post one before/after resume screenshot with a ₹300 offer link in 5 named college WhatsApp groups daily, plus reply to every placement-related message in those groups.

first_10_customers: Ask 5 batchmates for their current resume, rewrite one page free, send back the tracked-changes Google Doc, and request a 2-sentence testimonial plus permission to post the screenshot.
Post the before/after screenshot in 5 named hostel and class WhatsApp groups with the ₹300 Razorpay link, once per group per day for 7 days.
DM 20 final-year students from your own college's placement WhatsApp broadcast list individually with the 3-line cold message.
Offer the first 2 paid reviews at ₹300 (discount, not spend) in exchange for a WhatsApp video testimonial you can post as a Reel.
Ask each paying customer to forward your Carrd link to 3 batchmates who are also in placement season; give them a free LinkedIn headline rewrite as thanks.
Repeat the WhatsApp group post with a new before/after screenshot every week until 10 paying customers are delivered.
growth.cold_message: Hi [Name], saw you're in final year at [College] — placement drives usually filter resumes on ATS keywords before a human reads them. I'll rewrite your 1 page resume + LinkedIn headline for ₹300, delivered in 48 hours on WhatsApp, and you only pay after I send the before/after draft. Want me to send a free sample rewrite of your current resume's top 2 bullet points first?

objections.objection: I can just use ChatGPT for free.
objections.response: ChatGPT gives generic output; I rewrite against actual Indian campus drive JDs and send you a free sample of 2 bullet points so you can compare before paying ₹300.

objections.objection: I'll do it later, placements are still 6 weeks away.
objections.response: The first shortlist rounds fill before Day 0 — sending me your resume this week means you're in the first batch of applicants, not scrambling after the drive starts.

critic.verdict: The plan is highly realistic and strictly adheres to the bootstrapped, student-founder constraints, utilizing a zero-cost tech stack and campus-first distribution. The revenue model is sound for the Indian student market, with pricing that reflects the low willingness-to-pay for one-time services. The primary weakness is the aggressive assumption that organic WhatsApp reach will consistently convert at a scale sufficient to meet the 90-day targets without paid amplification.
critic.biggest_risk: The growth strategy relies entirely on organic reach in college WhatsApp groups, which often suffers from high noise and low conversion; if the 'before/after' posts do not generate immediate viral traction or referrals, the founder will hit a customer acquisition wall before reaching the 20-customer target by Day 90.
